title: Biased expectation polynomial
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and a real parameter $\mu$, define the biased expectation polynomial by $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\mu^{|S|}\widehat f(S)$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube with $n$ coordinates
